title: Surreal Occult Dreamscape
description: A surreal dark fantasy scene features a large central lotus flower with a curled cat tail stem, containing a glowing red and blue eyed cat face. Below it, a circular wreath frames a robed skeletal figure holding a flaming staff beside a small cat. In the sky, a winged shadowy figure flies above a skull-covered celestial sphere with purple rings, while dead trees, cracked red earth, floating skulls, and ghostly apparitions fill the foreground and background.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy painting featuring a giant ornate lotus flower with a curling cat tail stem and a cat face with glowing red and blue eyes at its center. Below, a circular wreath frame contains a robed skeleton wizard holding a flaming staff standing next to a small cat. A winged shadowy angel flies in the upper left sky. A large skull-covered celestial orb with purple rings floats in the upper right. Foreground shows cracked red glowing earth, dead twisted trees with hanging moss, and floating skulls under a dramatic red and blue nebula sky.
